parameters.query:
-- Startpunkt: jüngster gespeicherter Ledger-Eintrag. Bei leerer Tabelle
-- ETSY_SYNC_START (etsy.sync_start, deutsche Zeit), sonst 90 Tage – derselbe
-- Startpunkt wie beim Bestell-Sync (Workflow 01).
WITH start AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT MAX(date) FROM etsy_transactions),
    (SELECT value::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
       FROM app_config WHERE scope = 'etsy' AND key = 'sync_start'),
    NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
  ) AS ts
)
SELECT
  (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE scope = 'etsy' AND key = 'api_key')  AS api_key,
  (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE scope = 'etsy' AND key = 'shop_id') AS shop_id,
  start.ts                                AS last_sync,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM start.ts)::BIGINT    AS last_sync_ts
FROM start;

INSERT INTO etsy_transactions (
  transaction_id, order_id, type, description,
  amount, fee_amount, net_amount,
  currency, date, month,
  ledger_type, reference_type, reference_id
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4,
  $5::numeric, $6::numeric, $7::numeric,
  $8, $9::timestamptz, $10,
  $11, $12, $13
)
-- Beträge und Datum eines Ledger-Eintrags ändern sich nie. Die Einordnung
-- schon (Map erweitert): wird ein Eintrag erneut abgerufen, korrigieren.
ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO UPDATE SET
  type           = EXCLUDED.type,
  order_id       = EXCLUDED.order_id,
  ledger_type    = EXCLUDED.ledger_type,
  reference_type = EXCLUDED.reference_type,
  reference_id   = EXCLUDED.reference_id
WHERE (etsy_transactions.type, etsy_transactions.order_id, etsy_transactions.ledger_type,
       etsy_transactions.reference_type, etsy_transactions.reference_id)
      IS DISTINCT FROM
      (EXCLUDED.type, EXCLUDED.order_id, EXCLUDED.ledger_type,
       EXCLUDED.reference_type, EXCLUDED.reference_id);
